implementations.name: KIVI
implementations.supports_ampere_3090: confirmed: CUDA extension compiled for sm_86 with CUDA 12.4/PyTorch 2.4.0
implementations.supports_llama_gqa: confirmed by Llama 3.2 1B (32 Q heads/8 KV heads) and Llama 3.1 8B (32 Q heads/8 KV heads) runs after compatibility adaptation
implementations.layout: K per-channel over token groups, V per-token over head-dimension groups; packed int32 codes, FP16 scale/min metadata, FP16 residual window
implementations.precision: 2 or 4 bits; residual recent tokens remain FP16
implementations.optimized_decode: confirmed: upstream Triton pack/decode plus kivi_gemv CUDA GEMV path consumed during incremental decode

implementations.name: KVQuant
implementations.supports_ampere_3090: CUDA extension compiled successfully for sm_86 with local CUDA 12.4/PyTorch 2.4.0
implementations.supports_llama_gqa: blocked: deployment/transformers/src/transformers/models/llama/modeling_llama.py:1408 asserts num_key_value_groups == 1; local Llama 3.x has 32/8 GQA
implementations.layout: packed 2/3/4-bit cache with NUQ lookup tables and optional sparse outliers; separate K/V cache objects
implementations.precision: 2/3/4 bits in deployment kernels, with optional FP16 first tokens and sparse outlier storage
implementations.optimized_decode: confirmed in source: quant_cuda fused K/Q and attention matmul/append entry points; end-to-end local GQA reproduction blocked before model execution

implementations.name: Kitty
implementations.public_complete_enough: partial for this study: current tree has Kitty cache/Triton kernels and Qwen3 integration, but no Llama model wrapper and its required Transformers/lm-eval submodules were not initialized
implementations.supports_ampere_3090: confirmed for the public Triton kernels on RTX 3090; no CUDA extension required
implementations.supports_llama_gqa: kernel-level GQA portability confirmed with Llama 3.2 1B dimensions (32 Q heads/8 KV heads/D64); end-to-end Llama support absent in this commit
implementations.layout: paged uint8 K/V payloads, FP16 metadata, 128-token pages, 32-token FP16 sink, 25% K channel promotion from INT2 to INT4, FP16 local/value buffer
implementations.precision: K2/V2 with 25% key channels K4 in the shipped Kitty-Pro policy
implementations.optimized_decode: confirmed at kernel level: upstream Triton quantize-pack K/V and fused qk/sv attention

implementations.name: QAQ
implementations.supports_ampere_3090: not attempted: source has no CUDA/Triton/C++ kernel build
implementations.supports_llama_gqa: not established; evaluator uses generic Transformers past_key_values and source predates the local Llama 3 path
implementations.layout: dequantized FP16 tensors returned by Quantizer; quantized integer payload is not retained for attention
implementations.optimized_decode: negative: src/quantizer.py returns denormalized FP16 tensors and src/evaluator.py feeds those tensors to ordinary model.forward; no low-bit storage or fused decode path
